summary: Round kit play CPU receipts and policy ceilings to millisecond precision

replay.detail: CI harness only; no replay changes.

rules.detail: No product rule or case-set changes.

compatibility.detail: CPU seconds and the derived CPU ceiling are rounded to milliseconds before receipt emission and budget comparison. The 413.9-second anchor yields an exact 455.29-second ceiling, and non-commit runs retain rounded CPU telemetry without enforcing the commit CPU policy. Other receipt fields and wall guard behavior are unchanged.
